messages:
Elaine - Partnerships: Quick sync — Aurelia Compute wants to go live in eu-west-3 (digitalocean-like region) next month and they want a joint marketplace listing + press blurb. Need capacity entitlement, marketplace SKU, and legal signoff by EOW.

Mike - Cloud Ops: Can we get their target SKU/peak qps and a list of instance SKUs? I asked infra for a rough capacity map.

Raj - Sales Eng: Aurelia said initial demand: 6 reserved nodes (nvidia-rtx80 equiv) with 2x burst for first 2 weeks. Expected steady QPS ~120rps. Numbers came from partner launch forecasts.

Elaine - Partnerships: Timeline: partner asks to announce on 2026-04-15. We need: quota approval from cloud marketplace, KMS entitlements, listing metadata, and legal press language by 2026-04-01.

Priya - Product: Product note — we need to ship a dedicated model variant behind the listing (small/med/large) and ensure model pinning works in Private for customers that opt in. Also confirm that the streaming endpoint is enabled for the SKU.

Mike - Cloud Ops: tagging @infra-bot to provision test pool and open quota ticket.

infra-bot: Ticket created: Q-54231. Assigned to cloud-quotas. ETA for reviewer: 48h.

Elaine - Partnerships: @Sarah - Legal, can you review partner MSA + the joint announcement draft? Partner sent a short blurb — they want us to call out "managed low-latency inference in eu-west-3" and a quote from Aurelia.

Sarah - Legal: I reviewed the redlines. Two asks: 1) we need explicit approval for the quote text (partner must sign off), 2) confirm data residency phrase — we should avoid absolute claims. I'll prepare a short buffer clause and circulate. Need partner signature by 2026-03-28.

Raj - Sales Eng: Also need marketplace entitlements: KMS enabled for customers, and private deployment option shown in listing. Partner asked for a private beta toggle. Is that supported?

Priya - Product: Yes — the listing can show "Private deployment available" once Private teams enable tenant onboarding. We should add an affordance in the listing copy for "Contact sales for private deployment."

Mike - Cloud Ops: Quota snippet I just submitted to cloud-quotas (copy/paste):

```
region: eu-west-3
sku: aurelia-rtx80-x8
requested: 6
burst: 12
notes: reserved for initial launch, monitor for autoscale
```

Elaine - Partnerships: Action items I’ll track: 1) partner to sign quote (Aurelia) by 3/28; 2) legal to send final blurb 3/26; 3) cloud quotas approval by 3/30; 4) marketplace metadata by 4/2; 5) joint press draft by 4/5.

Mike - Cloud Ops: Small ops note — we need service account for marketplace provisioning with the right scope (marketplace:publish, kms:wrap). Please DM me the contact.

Sarah - Legal: I'll add a short FAQ line about data residency and limits to the blurb.

Raj - Sales Eng: I'll prep the partner enablement doc + a short runbook for SIs (how to route keys, how to fallback to smaller model). Will post draft in #eng-runtime tomorrow.

Elaine - Partnerships: Quick check — anyone foresee regulatory issues for eu-west-3 specific wording?

Priya - Product: No red flags from product. We'll run the release through compliance but looks fine.

Mike - Cloud Ops: Once quota ticket is approved I'll update this thread with the ticket number and expected provisioning window.

infra-bot: Q-54231 status: PENDING_REVIEW -> APPROVED (provisional). Provision window: 2026-04-02 to 2026-04-04.

Elaine - Partnerships: Great — provisional approved. Last item: coordinated embargo for press? Aurelia prefers 04/15 but asks for a 48h embargo. Recommend joint send on 04/15 09:00 UTC and embargo for partners 04/13. @Sarah please note in the release doc.

Sarah - Legal: Noted. I'll add an embargo clause and create a one-pager for comms approvals.

Raj - Sales Eng: I'll sync with field on entitlements and set up partner enablement session the week of launch.

Elaine - Partnerships: Thanks all. Next check-in Friday 09:30 UTC. If anything blocks earlier ping me. :thumbsup:

Mike - Cloud Ops: pinged cloud-quotas channel to confirm capacity mapping and autoscale baseline.

Elaine - Partnerships: (added) checklist for release: [partner quote signed, legal blurb, quota approved, marketplace SKU published, press draft approved, SI runbook complete].

Priya - Product: I'll attach the model variant matrix and release changelog to the marketplace PR once approved.

Elaine - Partnerships: closing notes — please keep replies short here, escalate to 1:1 for long threads. thanks!
